verdict.rationale: Docs confirm card creation, replacement for lost/stolen/damaged/expired cards, and general card management via API (stripe-issuing-docs-1, -7, -20), consistent with a full lifecycle API, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents activate/pause/unpause status transitions or permanent closure endpoints, nor explicitly ties a reissued card back to the original via a reference field. missing for 10: explicit docs on card status (active/inactive/canceled) transitions, pause/unpause semantics, and confirmation that replacement cards are linked to the original card object.
